svg.aria-label: The lost-wax caster: a foundrywoman tips a vessel of molten bronze into a clay mould while the wax original runs out of the base in bright rivulets, and the finished casting cools behind her carrying every fingerprint of the wax.
svg.title: THANATOS - the lost-wax caster
svg.text: Migrate the stack. Preserve the behaviour. Prove it.
